label: Calculus
shortDescription: A free university calculus course: limits, derivatives, integrals, series, differential equations, and multivariable calculus.
modulesDescription: Read the calculus chapters in order, or jump directly to the topic you need.
ogTitle: Learn Calculus for Free — Step-by-Step | CalcPath
ogDescription: Free university calculus course. Limits, derivatives, integrals, series, differential equations, and multivariable calculus — 13 textbook-depth chapters with proofs, worked examples, and 1,300+ practice problems with step-by-step solutions.
courseDescription: Free university calculus course covering limits, derivatives, integrals and techniques of integration, sequences and series, differential equations, parametric and polar curves, and multivariable and vector calculus. Every chapter has definitions, proofs, worked examples, and practice problems with step-by-step solutions.

topics.title: Limits & Continuity
topics.description: Build intuition for approaching values and continuity.

topics.title: Derivatives
topics.description: Compute derivatives and interpret rates of change.

topics.title: Applications of Derivatives
topics.description: Extrema, the Mean Value Theorem, curve sketching, optimization, related rates, and Newton's method.

topics.title: Integrals
topics.description: The definite integral, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, substitution, and numerical integration.

topics.title: Techniques of Integration
topics.description: Integration by parts, trigonometric integrals and substitutions, partial fractions, improper integrals, and choosing a strategy.

topics.title: Applications of Integration
topics.description: Areas, volumes, arc length, surface area, work, hydrostatic force, center of mass, and probability.

topics.title: Differential Equations
topics.description: First- and second-order equations, direction fields, Euler's method, models, and oscillations.

topics.title: Parametric Equations and Polar Coordinates
topics.description: Parametric curves, polar coordinates, and conic sections.

topics.title: Sequences & Series
topics.description: Sequences, convergence tests, power series, and Taylor series.

topics.title: Vectors, Space Curves, and Motion
topics.description: Vectors in three dimensions, lines and planes, quadric surfaces, vector functions, arc length, curvature, and motion in space.

topics.title: Partial Derivatives
topics.description: Functions of several variables, partial derivatives, the chain rule, gradients, and optimization with Lagrange multipliers.

topics.title: Multiple Integrals
topics.description: Double and triple integrals, polar, cylindrical and spherical coordinates, and change of variables.

topics.title: Vector Calculus
topics.description: Vector fields, line and surface integrals, and the theorems of Green, Stokes, and Gauss.
